ModMetaData.name: Paramedic: Don't Die Yet!
ModMetaData.author: bebranotyep
ModMetaData.description:
A field medic role, earned by wearing the uniform.
Put on the paramedic vest and beret (or helmet) and your colonist goes "on duty": better tending, safer surgery, faster rescues — and an oath. Kill or maim a human with your own hands and it will weigh on you for days.
• 8 uniform pieces across every apparel layer, from cheap cloth shirts to plasteel rescue jackets. • Abilities: Field Stabilization, "Medic! Hold your fire!" and Adrenaline. • Medicine pocket in the vest, ranks from Trainee to Legend, burnout, humanitarian goodwill.
Полевой медик, роль даётся формой. Английский и русский языки.
